text: That Women have fewer teeth
Never understood why aristotle thought so

A theory is because women smiled/laughed less in that era. Another is because women were less likely to have good nutrition and dental hygiene in the era. But my favourite is because women opened their mouths less so it was assumed they have a smaller mouth. 😅

Didn’t know about this Aristotle statement. My suspicion is that it is one of the many beliefs men arrived at because they wanted to believe them, not because they first looked at evidence and tried to come up with a theory to fit that evidence. Like the many origin myths of pastoral/agricultural societies where some creator god first creates a man, and only after that that the (usually male) god adds a woman to his creation, while all evidence screams in their faces that women bring forth life.
Yeah this makes sense. A lot of explanations are just so
